question: Why did the winch stop during normal operation?
raw:
**Troubleshooting table**
• Cause: Wait 2 minutes and attempt winch operation again. -> Action: Refer to para. 2-26 for winch operation. [Manual page 291]
• Cause: Other causes. -> Action: Notify unit maintenance. [Manual page 291]
• Cause: Check to see if voltmeter is in red or yellow (engine not running). -> Action: Start engine and charge batteries. [Manual page 291]
• Cause: Check to see if clutch lever is engaged (para. 2-26). -> Action: If not, engage clutch lever. [Manual page 291]
• Cause: Electronic current limiter is being activated, indicating an overload condition. -> Action: (No action specified) [Manual page 196]
• Cause: Thermal switch is activated, indicating overheating. -> Action: Wait approximately two minutes to let winch cool off and allow thermal switch to reset. [Manual page 196]

**Other relevant information**
• Caution: Do not fully apply hand throttle during engine “NO LOAD” [Manual page 196]

**Limitations**
The troubleshooting table lists possible causes and does not diagnose this specific vehicle or machine. Recommended authorized technical support for repairs.
